points.title: How does seasonal strike frequency vary between day and night?
points.code:
from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Place the supplied CSV beside the notebook or set DATA_PATH before this cell.
data_path = Path(globals().get('DATA_PATH', 'birdstrikes.csv'))
df = pd.read_csv(data_path, keep_default_na=False)
df['Flight Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Flight Date'], errors='coerce')
for column in ['Cost Other', 'Cost Repair', 'Cost Total $', 'Speed IAS in knots']:
    df[column] = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors='coerce').replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

# keep_default_na=False preserves the real category "None".
def category(series):
    return series.astype('string').fillna('').str.strip().replace('', '(Not reported)')

plt.style.use('dark_background')
plt.rcParams.update({'font.size': 11, 'axes.spines.top': False,
                     'axes.spines.right': False, 'figure.dpi': 110})
assert len(df) == 10000
assert df['Effect Amount of damage'].eq('None').sum() == 8939

# Seasonal report counts for Day and Night; Dawn/Dusk are separate categories.
time = category(df['Time of day'])
valid_date = df['Flight Date'].notna()
included = valid_date & time.isin(['Day', 'Night'])
counts = pd.crosstab(df.loc[included, 'Flight Date'].dt.month, time[included])
counts = counts.reindex(index=range(1, 13), columns=['Day', 'Night'], fill_value=0)
assert int(counts.to_numpy().sum()) == int(included.sum())
result_table = counts.rename_axis('Month').reset_index()
totals = counts.sum()
peaks = {group: int(counts[group].idxmax()) for group in counts}
summary_text = (
    f"Day: {totals['Day']:,} reports; peak month {peaks['Day']} "
    f"({counts.loc[peaks['Day'], 'Day']:,} reports). Night: {totals['Night']:,} reports; "
    f"peak month {peaks['Night']} ({counts.loc[peaks['Night'], 'Night']:,} reports). "
    f"Excluded: {(~valid_date).sum():,} missing/unparseable dates and "
    f"{(valid_date & ~time.isin(['Day', 'Night'])).sum():,} other time-of-day reports. "
    "These are counts in a historical sample with partial first/last years, not exposure-adjusted rates."
)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4.6))
for group, color in [('Day', '#fbbf24'), ('Night', '#7dd3fc')]:
    ax.plot(counts.index, counts[group], marker='o', color=color,
            label=f'{group} (n={totals[group]:,})')
ax.set(xticks=range(1, 13), xlabel='Calendar month', ylabel='Reported strikes')
ax.set_title('Seasonal counts of day and night reports', pad=12)
ax.legend(frameon=False)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.15)
fig.text(.02, .02, 'Historical sample: Jan 1990–Jul 2002. Report counts, not exposure-adjusted risk.', fontsize=9, color='#cbd5e1')
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, .06, 1, 1))
integrity = {'included': int(included.sum()), 'excluded': int((~included).sum()),
             'denominator_sum': int(counts.to_numpy().sum()), 'group_counts': totals.to_dict()}

print(textwrap.fill(summary_text, width=50))
print()
print(result_table.to_string(index=False))
plt.show()

from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Place the supplied CSV beside the notebook or set DATA_PATH before this cell.
data_path = Path(globals().get('DATA_PATH', 'birdstrikes.csv'))
df = pd.read_csv(data_path, keep_default_na=False)
df['Flight Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Flight Date'], errors='coerce')
for column in ['Cost Other', 'Cost Repair', 'Cost Total $', 'Speed IAS in knots']:
    df[column] = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors='coerce').replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

# keep_default_na=False preserves the real category "None".
def category(series):
    return series.astype('string').fillna('').str.strip().replace('', '(Not reported)')

plt.style.use('dark_background')
plt.rcParams.update({'font.size': 11, 'axes.spines.top': False,
                     'axes.spines.right': False, 'figure.dpi': 110})
assert len(df) == 10000
assert df['Effect Amount of damage'].eq('None').sum() == 8939

# Compare the month profile within each reported wildlife-size group.
size = category(df['Wildlife Size'])
included = df['Flight Date'].notna() & size.isin(['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'])
counts = pd.crosstab(df.loc[included, 'Flight Date'].dt.month, size[included])
counts = counts.reindex(index=range(1, 13), columns=['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'], fill_value=0)
totals = counts.sum()
assert int(totals.sum()) == int(included.sum())
percent = counts.div(totals, axis=1).mul(100)
assert np.allclose(percent.sum().to_numpy(), 100)
result_table = pd.DataFrame({'Month': range(1, 13)})
for group in counts:
    result_table[group + ' reports'] = counts[group].to_numpy()
    result_table[group + ' share (%)'] = percent[group].round(2).to_numpy()
peak_parts = []
for group in counts:
    peak = int(counts[group].idxmax())
    peak_parts.append(f"{group}: n={totals[group]:,}, peak month {peak}, "
                      f"{counts.loc[peak, group]:,} reports ({percent.loc[peak, group]:.1f}%)")
summary_text = '; '.join(peak_parts) + (
    f". Excluded {(~included).sum():,} reports with missing dates or other/missing size labels. "
    "Percentages use each size group's reports as the denominator; sample coverage is incomplete at the beginning/end."
)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4.6))
for group, color in [('Small', '#94a3b8'), ('Medium', '#7dd3fc'), ('Large', '#fbbf24')]:
    ax.plot(percent.index, percent[group], marker='o', color=color,
            linewidth=2.5 if group == 'Large' else 1.5, label=f'{group} (n={totals[group]:,})')
ax.set(xticks=range(1, 13), xlabel='Calendar month', ylabel="Share of each size group's reports (%)")
ax.set_title('Seasonal profile by reported wildlife size', pad=12)
ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=3)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.15)
fig.text(.02, .02, 'Each line sums to 100%. Historical report sample, not a measure of wildlife exposure.', fontsize=9, color='#cbd5e1')
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, .06, 1, 1))
integrity = {'included': int(included.sum()), 'excluded': int((~included).sum()),
             'denominator_sum': int(totals.sum()), 'group_counts': totals.to_dict(),
             'percent_sums': percent.sum().to_dict()}

print(textwrap.fill(summary_text, width=50))
print()
print(result_table.to_string(index=False))
plt.show()

points.code:
from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Place the supplied CSV beside the notebook or set DATA_PATH before this cell.
data_path = Path(globals().get('DATA_PATH', 'birdstrikes.csv'))
df = pd.read_csv(data_path, keep_default_na=False)
df['Flight Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Flight Date'], errors='coerce')
for column in ['Cost Other', 'Cost Repair', 'Cost Total $', 'Speed IAS in knots']:
    df[column] = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors='coerce').replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

# keep_default_na=False preserves the real category "None".
def category(series):
    return series.astype('string').fillna('').str.strip().replace('', '(Not reported)')

plt.style.use('dark_background')
plt.rcParams.update({'font.size': 11, 'axes.spines.top': False,
                     'axes.spines.right': False, 'figure.dpi': 110})
assert len(df) == 10000
assert df['Effect Amount of damage'].eq('None').sum() == 8939

# Empirical speed distributions; retain zero, exclude missing speed and unmapped labels.
speed = df['Speed IAS in knots']
damage = category(df['Effect Amount of damage'])
size = category(df['Wildlife Size'])
damage_labels = ['None', 'Minor', 'Medium', 'Substantial']
size_labels = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
valid_speed = speed.notna() & speed.ge(0)
known_damage = damage.isin(damage_labels)
known_size = size.isin(size_labels)
included = valid_speed & known_damage & known_size
selected = pd.DataFrame({'Wildlife size': size[included], 'Damage label': damage[included], 'Speed': speed[included]})
grouped = selected.groupby(['Wildlife size', 'Damage label'])['Speed']
summary = grouped.agg(Reports='count', Median='median')
summary['Q1'] = grouped.quantile(.25)
summary['Q3'] = grouped.quantile(.75)
result_table = summary.round(2).reset_index()
assert int(summary['Reports'].sum()) == int(included.sum())
missing_or_negative = int((~valid_speed).sum())
unmapped_after_speed = int((valid_speed & ~known_damage).sum())
missing_size_after_other = int((valid_speed & known_damage & ~known_size).sum())
assert int(included.sum()) + missing_or_negative + unmapped_after_speed + missing_size_after_other == len(df)
size_counts = selected.groupby('Wildlife size').size().reindex(size_labels, fill_value=0)
summary_text = (
    f"{included.sum():,} reports are included: "
    + ', '.join(f'{s} n={size_counts[s]:,}' for s in size_labels)
    + f". Excluded sequentially: {missing_or_negative:,} missing/unparseable or negative speeds; "
    f"{unmapped_after_speed:,} remaining reports with unmapped damage labels; "
    f"{missing_size_after_other:,} remaining reports with other/missing size labels. "
    f"{int((included & speed.eq(0)).sum())} zero-speed reports are retained. "
    "Each box shows observed speed by literal damage label and size; these distributions do not estimate causal effects or damage risk."
)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(13, 4.8), sharey=True)
colors = ['#38bdf8', '#fbbf24', '#fb923c', '#fb7185']
for ax, wildlife_size in zip(axes, size_labels):
    values, positions, counts = [], [], []
    for j, label in enumerate(damage_labels):
        group = selected.loc[selected['Wildlife size'].eq(wildlife_size) & selected['Damage label'].eq(label), 'Speed']
        counts.append(len(group))
        if len(group):
            values.append(group.to_numpy()); positions.append(j + 1)
    boxes = ax.boxplot(values, positions=positions, patch_artist=True,
                       flierprops={'marker': '.', 'markersize': 3, 'markeredgecolor': '#94a3b8'},
                       medianprops={'color': '#ffffff', 'linewidth': 1.4})
    for box, position in zip(boxes['boxes'], positions):
        box.set(facecolor=colors[position - 1], alpha=.55, edgecolor=colors[position - 1])
    ax.set_xticks(range(1, 5), [f'{label}\nn={count:,}' for label, count in zip(damage_labels, counts)], fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title(f'{wildlife_size} wildlife (n={size_counts[wildlife_size]:,})', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_xlabel('Recorded damage label', fontsize=10)
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.15)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Reported indicated airspeed (knots)')
fig.suptitle('Reported speed by damage label and wildlife size', fontsize=14, y=.98)
fig.text(.02, .015, 'Boxes: quartiles and median; whiskers: 1.5×IQR. B/C labels are not decoded. Zero speeds retained.', fontsize=9, color='#cbd5e1')
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, .07, 1, .94))
integrity = {'included': int(included.sum()), 'excluded': int((~included).sum()),
             'denominator_sum': int(summary['Reports'].sum()), 'missing_or_negative_speed': missing_or_negative,
             'unmapped_damage_after_valid_speed': unmapped_after_speed, 'other_size_after_valid_speed_damage': missing_size_after_other,
             'zero_speeds_retained': int((included & speed.eq(0)).sum()), 'size_counts': size_counts.to_dict()}

print(textwrap.fill(summary_text, width=50))
print()
print(result_table.to_string(index=False))
plt.show()

points.title: Are day and night reports associated with different damage labels?
points.code:
from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Place the supplied CSV beside the notebook or set DATA_PATH before this cell.
data_path = Path(globals().get('DATA_PATH', 'birdstrikes.csv'))
df = pd.read_csv(data_path, keep_default_na=False)
df['Flight Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Flight Date'], errors='coerce')
for column in ['Cost Other', 'Cost Repair', 'Cost Total $', 'Speed IAS in knots']:
    df[column] = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors='coerce').replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

# keep_default_na=False preserves the real category "None".
def category(series):
    return series.astype('string').fillna('').str.strip().replace('', '(Not reported)')

plt.style.use('dark_background')
plt.rcParams.update({'font.size': 11, 'axes.spines.top': False,
                     'axes.spines.right': False, 'figure.dpi': 110})
assert len(df) == 10000
assert df['Effect Amount of damage'].eq('None').sum() == 8939

# Compare literal damage-label composition within Day and Night reports.
time = category(df['Time of day'])
damage = category(df['Effect Amount of damage'])
included = time.isin(['Day', 'Night'])
labels = ['None', 'Minor', 'Medium', 'Substantial', 'B', 'C']
labels += sorted(set(damage[included]) - set(labels))
counts = pd.crosstab(time[included], damage[included]).reindex(index=['Day', 'Night'], columns=labels, fill_value=0)
totals = counts.sum(axis=1)
percent = counts.div(totals, axis=0).mul(100)
assert int(totals.sum()) == int(included.sum())
assert np.allclose(percent.sum(axis=1).to_numpy(), 100)
records = []
for group in counts.index:
    for label in labels:
        records.append({'Time of day': group, 'Damage label': label,
                        'Reports': int(counts.loc[group, label]),
                        'Within-time share (%)': round(float(percent.loc[group, label]), 2)})
result_table = pd.DataFrame(records)
summary_text = (
    f"Day n={totals['Day']:,}: {counts.loc['Day', 'None']:,} reports ({percent.loc['Day', 'None']:.1f}%) "
    f"are labelled None. Night n={totals['Night']:,}: {counts.loc['Night', 'None']:,} "
    f"({percent.loc['Night', 'None']:.1f}%) are labelled None. "
    f"{(~included).sum():,} Dawn/Dusk or other time labels are excluded. "
    "B and C are retained as literal, unmapped labels. Percentages are within reported time groups, not exposure-adjusted damage risk."
)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
left = np.zeros(2)
palette = ['#38bdf8', '#fbbf24', '#fb923c', '#fb7185', '#c084fc', '#94a3b8']
for j, label in enumerate(labels):
    values = percent[label].to_numpy()
    bars = ax.barh(range(2), values, left=left, label=label, color=palette[j % len(palette)], height=.48)
    for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, values)):
        if value >= 4.5:
            ax.text(left[i] + value / 2, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                    f'{value:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=10, color='#101827')
    left += values
ax.set_yticks(range(2), [f'{g}\n(n={totals[g]:,})' for g in counts.index])
ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set(xlim=(0, 100), xlabel="Share of each time group's reports (%)")
ax.set_title('Damage labels recorded in day and night reports', pad=12)
ax.legend(title='Literal damage label', ncol=6, frameon=False, loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(.5, -.2), fontsize=9)
fig.text(.02, .015, 'Each row sums to 100%. B/C retained without interpretation; no flight-count denominator is available.', fontsize=9, color='#cbd5e1')
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, .12, 1, 1))
integrity = {'included': int(included.sum()), 'excluded': int((~included).sum()),
             'denominator_sum': int(totals.sum()), 'group_counts': totals.to_dict(),
             'percent_sums': percent.sum(axis=1).to_dict(), 'labels_retained': labels}

print(textwrap.fill(summary_text, width=50))
print()
print(result_table.to_string(index=False))
plt.show()
